title: feat(nm2orioney): lex-one signed-outgoing det orientation of 1-in 2-out at t+1 on two-axis opposite y-probes: reverse HOLD, face fails
science: Orientation convention #3 (lex-one signed: pick +e_i over -e_i on each O-axis) on opposite y-probes: +1,+1,-1,fail -> reverse HOLD, face fail, where the opposite-pair convention (#7394) gives fail/fail and the unique-signed convention gives +1,fail,fail,fail on the same cell. Its own text concedes 'unsigned Orient at A is -1 while this Orient is +1'.
